name: perspective_view_validate

inputBounds.documentForm: JSON text of the whole View document; the server performs the parse so that the byte ceiling is measured on the caller's own bytes
inputBounds.requiredStructure: a JSON object with a 'root' object whose 'type' is a string
inputBounds.unknownComponentTypes: accepted: this validator checks structure and budget, never the component inventory of a particular Ignition patch

offlineValidationIsNotAcceptance: a passing validation does not promise that an Ignition import accepts the document (D15)
